source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 513 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 513 was established by Ordinance No. 23562, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 24, 1998. Ordinance No. 23562 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 513 is established on property generally located at the west corner of South Central Expressway and Coombs Street. The size of PD 513 is approximately 2.94 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Conceptual/Development And Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.104. CONCEPTUAL/DEVELOPMENT AND LANDSCAPE PLAN.

The conceptual/development and landscape plan (Exhibit 513A) serves as a conceptual plan for Tract 1 and a development plan for Tract 2. Development of Tracts 1 and 2 must comply with the plan. In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the conceptual/development and landscape plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan For Tract 1
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN FOR TRACT 1.

A development plan for Tract 1 must be approved by the city plan commission prior to the issuance of any building permit on Tract 1. Development and use of the property must comply with the approved development plan. The development plan and any amendments must comply with this article. An amendment to the development plan, other than a minor amendment authorized by the director pursuant to Subsection 51A-4.702(h), only requires the approval of the city plan commission. If the city plan commission fails to approve a development plan, or an amendment to an approved development plan, the applicant may appeal the decision to the city council. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Multifamily uses.

(b) All uses permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District by specific use permit
(SUP) is permitted in this PD by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the IM Industrial Manufacturing District is subject to DIR in this PD. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) In general. Except as provided below, the yard, lot, and space regulations of the IM Industrial Manufacturing District apply to the Property.

(b) Lot coverage. Maximum permitted lot coverage is 80 percent. For purposes of calculating lot coverage, the Property is considered one lot.

(c) Dwelling unit density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(d) Setbacks.

(1) Tract 1. Front, side, and rear yard setbacks must comply the conceptual/development and landscape plan.

(2) Tract 2.

(A) Except as provided in Subparagraph (B), no minimum front, side, and rear yard setbacks.

(B) Minimum setback along the southeastern boundary of the Property is 10 feet. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Required off-street parking must be provided as follows:

(1) For those retail and personal service uses listed in Section 51A-4.123(d)(2)(J), off-street must be provided in accordance with the requirements of Division 51A-4.200.

(2) For all other uses, required off-street parking must be provided at a ratio of one parking space per 500 square feet of floor area.

(b) Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Sections 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Tract 1. A landscape plan must be approved by the city plan commission before issuance of a building permit on Tract 1. Landscaping must be provided in accordance with the approved landscape plan prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy on Tract 1. An amendment to the approved landscape plan, other than a minor amendment authorized by the director pursuant to Subsection 51A-4.702(h), only requires the approval of the city plan commission. If the city plan commission fails to approve a landscape plan, or an amendment to an approved landscape plan, the applicant may appeal the decision to the city council.

(b) Tract 2. Landscaping for Tract 2 must be provided in accordance with the conceptual/development and landscape plan prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy on Tract 2.

(c) Maintenance. Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(d) Tree preservation. Prior to the issuance of a building permit, tree preservation criteria must be met as outlined in Article X. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.113. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the conceptual/development and landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.115. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-513.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 513 is located on Zoning Map No. K-8. (Ord. Nos. 23562; 26042)
